name: TCS34725 RGB colour sensor
description: ams (TAOS) TCS34725 colour light-to-digital converter: clear, red, green and blue photodiode channels with an IR-blocking filter, each a 16-bit count, over I2C at address 0x29 (fixed). Chip runs on 2.7-3.6 V; the breakout regulates to 3.3 V and level-shifts SDA/SCL so it takes 3.3-5 V. Sold as: Adafruit TCS34725 RGB Color Sensor with IR filter and White LED (#1334), 7-pin header VIN, GND, 3V3, SCL, SDA, INT, LED; the purple clone modules copy the same pin order.
eli5: Looks at the light falling on it and tells your board how much red, green and blue there is, so you can tell what colour something is.

pins.name: 3V3
pins.description: 3.3 V OUTPUT of the on-board regulator, not a supply input: leave unconnected

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock (10k pull-up and level shifter on board, 5 V safe)

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data (10k pull-up and level shifter on board, 5 V safe)

pins.name: INT
pins.description: Interrupt output, open-drain, active low, straight from the chip (3.3 V logic, no pull-up on board); not needed for basic use

pins.name: LED
pins.description: White LED enable, pulled up on board so the LED is on; pull low (GND or a GPIO driven low) to turn the LED off

supplierQuery: TCS34725 RGB color sensor breakout I2C
buildNotes: Every register access starts with a command byte: 0x80 | register (single byte) or 0xA0 | register (auto-increment). Writing the bare register number does nothing useful.
Power up: write ENABLE = 0x01 (PON), wait at least 2.4 ms, then ENABLE = 0x03 (PON + AEN). Check the ID register (0x92 command) reads 0x44 (0x4D on TCS34727-based clones).
Integration time = 2.4 ms x (256 - ATIME); the max count is 1024 x (256 - ATIME), capped at 65535. Wait for STATUS AVALID before reading.
Read all four channels in one 8-byte auto-increment read from 0xB4 (clear, red, green, blue, each low byte first).
The white LED is on by default; tie LED to GND to switch it off, or wire it to a GPIO and drive it low. Shield the sensor from stray light for repeatable colour readings.
The address 0x29 is fixed: only one TCS34725 per I2C bus.

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from tcs34725 import TCS34725

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
sensor = TCS34725(i2c)
while True:
    c, r, g, b = sensor.read_raw()
    print('C=%d R=%d G=%d B=%d' % (c, r, g, b))
    time.sleep(1)

test.title: Reports the clear, red, green and blue counts set on the sliders
